Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class ApiKeyAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.ApiKeyAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
ApiKeyPort
@Component public class ApiKeyAdapter extends Object implements ApiKeyPort
JPA-backed adapter implementing ApiKeyPort.

Converts between the domain ApiKey record and the ApiKeyEntity JPA entity for persistence.
